description: This file defines the SchemaHelper class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to manage database schema operations such as adding, dropping, and renaming columns and foreign keys, as well as creating tables and controlling constraints, primarily using Doctrine DBAL library.

classes.name: SchemaHelper
classes.description: Provides utility methods for managing and modifying database schemas, including adding, dropping, and changing columns, managing foreign keys, creating tables, and controlling constraints within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes SchemaHelper with a Doctrine DBAL Connection object, setting up the schema manager.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current Doctrine DBAL Connection.

methods.name: dropColumn
methods.description: Drops a specific column from a table.

methods.name: dropColumns
methods.description: Drops multiple columns from a table.

methods.name: getTableColumn
methods.description: Retrieves the Column object for a specific column in a table, if it exists.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager object used for database schema operations.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to a specified table.

methods.name: addOrChangeColumns
methods.description: Adds new columns or modifies existing columns based on provided options.

methods.name: changeColumn
methods.description: Changes the properties of an existing column.

methods.name: renameColumn
methods.description: Renames an existing column within a table.

methods.name: dropForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign key constraints from a table.

methods.name: addForeignKey
methods.description: Adds a foreign key constraint to a table.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table object with specified charset, collation, and engine options.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKey
methods.description: Drops the primary key from a table.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection object.

methods.name: disableConstraints
methods.description: Disables foreign key constraints temporarily.

methods.name: enableConstraints
methods.description: Enables foreign key constraints.

methods.name: columnExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific column exists in a table.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops an index from a table.
